contexts.text: In a lucid state as to the interiors. Signified.
The lucidity in which those live who pertain to a certain internal province of the face. Described.
(How the body is made) full of light. AE 313:15.
The exteriors appear as it were lucid.
Then comes the morning, or a lucid state.
A lucidity like the flaming solar lucidity, (which represented) their Intellectual.
A flaming lucidity = truth from good.

Around the column there was a lucidity which was variegated by something shining white, and which presented colours; by which things was signified the state of the Spiritual Church... The lucidity variegated by something shining white signified the Intellectual in which there was a new Voluntary from the Lord.

In such a state are the infernals; hence there sometimes appears a lucidity around them; but within this lucidity, where they themselves are, there is what is dusky, monstrous, and horrible. But with the Angels there is a flaming beam in the midst from the good of celestial and spiritual love, and a derivative lucidity or bright whiteness round about them.
After the obscurity and anxiety of temptations there appears what is lucid and glad...
The things in the Middle Heaven appear as something lucid in the Ultimate Heaven...
From that freedom in their minds there appeared a lucidity...
As it were smoke from Hell extinguished the lucidity which was above the memory...
The lucidity in which those live who constitute the internals of the nostrils. Described.
Are alternately in Hell and in a lucid world.
By means of that Doctrine they had made shining appearances in the air.
A bright cloud () = the Word in the letter in which is the internal sense.
